column1: # Questions for evaluating ask, phrased the way somebody who does not
# know slsh's command names would type them.  Every question is
# invented, and so is every name in one.  askcorpus_test.go has its own
# shorter list, which pins individual rankings; this one is measured as
# a whole, by askeval_test.go (retrieval, always) and
# askeval_model_test.go (a model, when one is named).
# One question per line, tab-separated:
#   question <TAB> commands [<TAB> flags]
# commands  the command or commands that answer it, space-separated;
#           any one of them counts as right.  "-" means slsh cannot do
#           it, and the right answer is "not found".  Most of those are
#           near misses: something beside a real command (paying beside
#           give, banning beside parcel, resetting a script beside
#           start) that the pages were read to confirm is not there.
# flags     optional, space-separated: flags of which a right answer
#           uses at least one.  Only the model eval looks at them.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.  A question that
# stops being right when a command changes is corrected here, in the
# same change.
# Inventory
what is in this folder
show my inventory with the dates and ids of things
which items did I get most recently
list everything in my inventory including what is in subfolders
what is inside that box sitting on the floor
open a notecard and read it
read the notecard that is inside a vendor
copy an item so I have two of it
move an item into a different folder
I have three copies of something, delete only the newest one
which folder am I in right now
go into my objects folder
search my whole inventory for anything called lamp
make a new script in my inventory
save a texture to my disk under a name I choose
# People
show all my friends, not only the ones online
what is the uuid of an avatar whose name I know
ask a friend to teleport me to them
tell my friend where I am so they can come over
decline an item somebody tried to give me
make a pending request stop being counted in my prompt without answering it
friend requests and item offers I have not answered yet
list the conversations I have open
switch into a mode where everything I type is chat
send a message on channel 7
# Places
go to my home location
remember this spot as a landmark
travel to a place I saved a landmark for
show every parcel in this region
draw a map of the land parcels around me
which regions border the one I am in
where on the grid is a region I have never been to
what are my exact coordinates
what is the maturity rating and water height of this region
does this region allow mesh uploads
how many attachments can an avatar wear here
# Objects and building
list the objects that belong to one particular person
show the individual prims inside linked objects
copy an object that is out in the world without removing it
rez an item from inventory at a specific position
make one face of my object fullbright
give an object a glow
make a face half transparent
click a particular face of a prim
hold the mouse button down on an object for a few seconds
make it so the next owner cannot modify what I sell them
break a linked object apart into separate prims
change a standing object so it matches a json file I edited
stop the scripts running in an object
# Wearing
wear a hat on my left hand instead of my head
swap out whatever is on that attachment point for something else
show the inventory keys of the things I have on
put my whole outfit back on
# LSL
list all the LSL events
print only the LSL constants
# The shell and the session
what commands are there
show me the manual page for a command
print a line of text
how is my connection to the simulator doing
show the raw protocol messages as they come in
which capabilities did the simulator give this session
which avatars can this shell log in as
sign this avatar out
leave the shell
upload a picture but only show what would happen
set up the worn objects that scripts get run in
launch a graphical viewer logged in as this avatar
# Things slsh cannot do.  Each was looked for in the pages.
pay another avatar a hundred linden dollars
buy the parcel I am standing on
ban an annoying avatar from my land
send back all the objects other people left on my parcel
reset a script so it starts over from the beginning
create a brand new group
change my display name
take a screenshot of what my avatar sees
make my avatar dance
upload a sound clip
list only the folders in my inventory, not the items
set the music stream for my parcel
change the time of day so it is sunset
play a gesture
edit what my own profile says about me
